Container.Name: tempo
Container.Overview:
Grafana Tempo, an open source, easy-to-use, and high-scale distributed tracing backend.
This all-in-one configuration runs the distributor, ingester, and querier components in a single process, accepting traces via OTLP (gRPC/HTTP) and storing them on local disk. Query traces through Grafana by adding Tempo as a data source pointed at this container's HTTP API port.
A tempo.yaml configuration file must exist at the mapped config path before starting the container.
https://grafana.com/oss/tempo/
Container.Description: Grafana Tempo all-in-one: distributor, ingester, and querier running as a single process. Accepts traces via OTLP (gRPC/HTTP) and persists them to local disk storage. Designed to be queried through Grafana rather than a standalone UI.

Config.Name: Config File
Config.Description: Path to the tempo.yaml configuration file. Must exist before starting the container.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Storage location for ingested trace data.

Config.Name: Container Port 1
Config.Description: Tempo HTTP API / query endpoint, used by Grafana as a data source.

Config.Name: Container Port 2
Config.Description: OTLP gRPC receiver for ingesting trace data from OpenTelemetry SDKs.

Config.Name: Container Port 3
Config.Description: OTLP HTTP receiver for ingesting trace data from OpenTelemetry SDKs.

Config.Name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
Config.Description: Optional OTLP endpoint for Tempo to export its own internal telemetry to, e.g. http://alloy:4318 if running an Alloy or OTel Collector instance. Leave blank to disable.
